content:
One of the most rewarding experiences for an advocate is when the Court seeks your assistance on a particular legal issue.

When a Judge asks you to assist the Court in identifying the applicable law, interpreting a legal provision, or finding the appropriate legal position to deal with a specific question of law, it is a moment of immense professional satisfaction.

It reflects the Court’s confidence in your ability to research, analyse, and assist in arriving at the correct legal position. For an advocate, there is perhaps no greater honour than being asked to assist the Court—not merely to argue for a client, but to contribute to the process of justice.

Because the true essence of advocacy is not just winning a case, but assisting the Court in finding the right law and arriving at the right decision.

#Advocacy #LegalProfession #Litigation #IndianJudiciary #Lawyers #Justice #LegalResearch #CourtroomPractice #Advocate
comment: The real test often comes when the legal position is unsettled or contrary to a party’s interests. Objectivity and precision in such moments are what make an advocate’s assistance truly valuable.
